base_architecture: t1/rl/artifacts/ppo_sm_50k.zip policy kwargs on an extended observation space (weights not copied)

deadzone.rule: fewest healthy false changes among the deadzones whose per-cell recovered and network success are within 0.01 of no deadzone's; ties to the smaller; no deadzone unless it reduces false changes

development_rule: dev data only; the held-out gate was not opened (guard installed)

hyper.loss: mse on the actor mean (8 dims), targets data.unit_target
hyper.net: ppo_sm_50k's policy kwargs (MultiInputPolicy 64-64 tanh, log_std_init -0.5) on the extended observation space

baseline.contract: t1/rl/remediation/README.md section 3 (v2): ran___propose replays the case's action log up to that step and passes both states with per-cell shares
baseline.step: fault_step - 1 (the step before the last configuration step preceding the incident)

meta.label: remediation-v2: behaviour cloning (+ residual DAgger) of the twin-verified way back to the commissioned configuration on fresh dev-split incidents; inputs: v1's masked observation plus KPI changes against the pre-incident baseline (no configuration history); deterministic
